name: The Oceanaire Seafood Room
notes: Permanently closed. sandiegoville.com (2020): 'The Oceanaire Seafood Room Permanently Closes In San Diego...after 15 years'. Yelp and its Facebook page both tag the 400 J St location closed. The chain's own site (theoceanaire.com) no longer lists a San Diego location among its 6 remaining branches (Boston, Dallas, Indianapolis, Minneapolis, Orlando, Washington DC); its /menu/ page (the router's source) is a generic restaurant-week template, not a San Diego menu.

name: Pizzaiolo
notes: Uber Eats schema.org Menu JSON-LD under Restaurant.hasMenu, address confirmed 554 Santa Fe Dr / Encinitas. 9 sections, no 'Most Ordered' carousel present, no duplicate blocks. Prices end in conventional .95/.00/.50 with no divisor pattern - not marked up. Restaurant's own Wix site (pizzaioloencinitas.wixsite.com/pizzaiolo) renders no menu content client-side, so this is the best available source.

name: Monty's Den
notes: Monty's Den was a bar/venue inside SDSU's original Aztec Center student union. SDSU Digital Collections records it 'changed names in 2001'. The Aztec Center building itself was demolished in 2011 (SDSU news release) and replaced by the Conrad Prebys Aztec Student Union (opened 2013) - the '149 Aztec Center' address no longer exists. No current Google Maps listing under this name. Permanently gone.

name: Carnitas’ Snack Shack
notes: The North Park original location at 2632 University Ave permanently closed (per localadventurer.com: 'the one in North Park closed down, but you can still get the food in Embarcadero'; mapquest tags it 'Permanently closed'; Yelp tags it closed). The brand's own site now lists only Embarcadero and Petco Park locations, confirming this branch no longer operates. Router's captured Toast payload was for the Embarcadero branch (1004 N Harbor Dr), a different address - do not attribute it here.

name: Bo Beau
notes: 4996 West Point Loma Blvd (formerly 'Thee Bungalow') was vacated by Bo-Beau and reopened in August 2023 as Ciao Elvira (obrag.org, June 2023 article; ciaoelvira.com confirms it is open at that address today). A separate 'BO-beau kitchen + rooftap' now trades under bobeaurooftap.com at a different location - not this address. Closed restaurant replaced by a differently-named successor at this address.

name: OB Garden Café
notes: 4741 Voltaire St is now Harumama Ramen + Buns + Sushi (opened 2022); SanDiegoVille's own post states it opened 'in the 2-story building that last housed OB Garden Café'. obgardencafe.coop no longer resolves (DNS failure). Closed restaurant replaced by a differently-named successor at this address.

name: George’s Rooftop
notes: No address given in the work list; identified as George's at the Cove's rooftop concept ('Ocean Terrace', 1250 Prospect St, La Jolla - gosandiego.com and multiple reviews describe 'a relaxing rooftop meal on the popular Ocean Terrace'). The venue's own /ocean-terrace page links to the same /menu-dinner, /menu-lunch and /menu-beverages pages as the /level2 page, confirming all of George's at the Cove's dining levels (California Modern, Level2/Bar, Ocean Terrace/Rooftop) share one kitchen menu. Squarespace menu blocks carry no explicit section-title markup; section labels below (Starters/Entrees/Desserts/Kids Menu/Beverages) are inferred from item groupings and daypart, not fabricated prices. Dropped one non-priced 'Add ons:' divider row per menu.
